summary_en: The caller, Sravani, requested general servicing for a split AC at her home in Madhapur and asked for a technician visit the next day at 10:00 AM. The agent quoted ₹599 and initially stated that no inspection fee would apply, while replacement parts would be charged separately at actual MRP after technician inspection. The caller then asked whether GST was extra, how appointment confirmation would be sent, how long spare-part replacement would take, whether itemized and separate parts bills would be provided, and whether the service included any warranty or guarantee. The agent repeatedly said these details were unavailable and did not confirm or book the appointment. The caller became frustrated, said she could not decide without the information, and ended the call. No appointment or follow-up was confirmed.

extracted_fields.spare_parts_pricing: Charged separately at actual MRP after inspection

facts.spare_parts_pricing: Charged separately at actual MRP after inspection

objections: Appointment confirmation method was not clarified
Spare-part replacement time was not clarified
